![Thai Glass Noodle Salad (Yum Woon Sen) Recipe & Video ยำวุ้นเส้น](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07280800-1672-0139-0000-4a19d4cc8f2e:7)
Yum woon sen is `a classic Thai glass noodle salad made with translucent mung bean noodles, minced pork, shrimp, and a bright, spicy-sour lime dressing` . It is tossed with fresh herbs and crisp vegetables and served warm or at room temperature.[](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/glass-noodle-salad-v2/) [[1]](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/glass-noodle-salad-v2/)[[2]](https://susiecooksthai.com/yum-woon-sen-thai-glass-noodle-salad-recipe/)[[3]](https://thaicaliente.com/yum-woonsen-thai-glass-noodle-salad/)[[4]](https://www.tiktok.com/@dudu.eats/video/7394897416136264992?lang=en-GB)[[5]](https://www.kikkoman.co.uk/recipes/detail/yum-woon-sen-thai-glass-noodle-salad)

Key Ingredients

- **Glass noodles** : Mung bean vermicelli (*woon sen* ) that turn clear and slippery when soaked and briefly boiled.
- **Proteins** : Ground pork and fresh shrimp (or seafood alternatives like squid).
- **Dressing** : Fresh lime juice, fish sauce, palm sugar, and fiery Thai bird's eye chilies.
- **Vegetables & Herbs** : Sliced shallots, celery, tomatoes, green onions, and fresh cilantro or mint.
- **Garnish** : Crushed roasted peanuts and optional dried shrimp.[](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/glass-noodle-salad-v2/) [[1]](https://www.seriouseats.com/yam-woon-sen-glass-noodle-salad-5206676)[[2]](https://www.marionskitchen.com/thai-glass-noodle-salad-yum-woon-sen/)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L1PPykgxb5E)

How to Prepare

- **Soak noodles** : Place dried glass noodles in room temperature or warm water for 7–10 minutes until soft, then drain and cut into shorter lengths with scissors.[](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/glass-noodle-salad-v2/) 
- **Cook proteins** : Boil or shallow-boil the minced pork and shrimp in a small amount of seasoned water until cooked through. Briefly blanch the softened noodles in the hot water for about 2 minutes.[](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/glass-noodle-salad-v2/) [[1]](https://nomadette.com/yum-woon-sen/)
- **Mix dressing** : Combine lime juice, fish sauce, sugar, and minced chilies and garlic in a large bowl.[](https://nomadette.com/yum-woon-sen/) 
- **Toss and serve** : Add the warm noodles, cooked pork, shrimp, and fresh crisp vegetables to the dressing, toss well, and top with roasted peanuts to serve immediately.[](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/glass-noodle-salad-v2/)
